hypothesis: Retain the native Greek alphabet while redistributing selected open-entry space and preserving diagonal exit clearance; relieve enclosed bold counters, reinforce script ink without closing counters, and restore a more flowing but distinct native Greek italic nu posture.
scope: 32 Greek forms × four serif styles × three existing optical roles; no unrelated glyph or radical changes.
parameters_are: A single designer proposal, not universal typographic numerical standards. Fixed specimens test it against the incumbent.
